sources.name: Overture Places
sources.offers: Trading names, premises, websites, phones and available emails/socials

sources.offers: Places, websites, available public contact tags

sources.name: PDL free company dataset
sources.offers: Domains, names, industry, size, location, LinkedIn company URLs

sources.terms: Subscription/field entitlements and data licence required

sources.name: Coresignal

sources.name: Cognism
sources.notes: Benchmark UK coverage; no subscription purchased

sources.name: Apollo
sources.offers: Company/person search, enrichment and account CSV export
sources.notes: No authorised public full contact dump verified

sources.offers: Domain search, named email finding, verification
